sample_unit: AI research systems (evaluated on 3 NHANES clinical epidemiology tasks)

links.outcome: Citation integrity and weighted total score before and after adding multi-agent citation verification and repair pipeline
links.effect: Citation integrity score rose from 40.0 to 90.9; weighted total rose from 68.9 to 81.8 for the best-performing system.
links.quote: Adding a multi-agent citation verification and repair pipeline to the best-performing system improved its citation integrity score from 40.0 to 90.9 and raised the weighted total from 68.9 to 81.8.

links.outcome: System ranking under programmatic citation verification versus single-model LLM-only evaluation
links.effect: Single-model evaluation ranked the best system last (55.5); three-tier framework with programmatic citation verification ranked it first (81.8), a complete reversal.
links.quote: Strikingly, a single-model evaluation ranked this system last (55.5), while our three-tier framework ranked it first (81.8) —a complete reversal that exposes the limitations of subjective LLM-only evaluation.

links.outcome: Citation hallucination rates in AI-generated research manuscripts across six systems
links.effect: Hallucination rates ranged from 2.9% to 36.8% across systems; hard-rule citation threshold capped four of six systems' total scores at the penalty ceiling.
links.quote: Hallucination rates ranged from 2.9% to 36.8% across systems, and a hard-rule threshold on per-task citation scores capped four of six systems’ total scores at the penalty ceiling.

unlisted_practices: Multi-model LLM judging combined with programmatic and rule-based checks rather than single-judge LLM evaluation
Rule-based reporting-standard compliance checks for AI-generated manuscripts

screen.practice: multi-agent citation verification and repair pipeline
screen.reason: The paper benchmarks six AI research writing systems on clinical epidemiology tasks and specifically tests adding a multi-agent citation verification and repair guardrail pipeline to mitigate citation hallucination.

primary.practice: multi-agent citation verification and repair pipeline
